notes: 10 cases: 6 positive / 4 negative. Every case is an authored golden: the skill shipped 2026-10-15 (BRO-3117) with zero production invocations, so no real-trace cases exist and none are claimed. Re-cut against real transcripts once the skill has been used. 4 of 6 positives avoid the skill name so they measure paraphrase inference; the negatives are the neighbours this skill must not steal from (animate, video-cut, higgsfield, launch-video).

execution_contract.note: trigger-surface grading only; output quality is not gated here (taste is the open tier-J question)

known_gaps: output quality ungated: a tier-J judge over contact sheets does not exist yet

cases.prompt: make a 6 second seamless loop of our logo pouring into place, for an X post
cases.rationale: Explicit rendered-motion ask with no engine named; the skill must pick the engine and canvas first and direct with numbers rather than return a one-shot file.

cases.prompt: the title card animation flickers between renders and hiccups where the loop restarts
cases.rationale: Two contract symptoms (impurity, frame N rendered) described without the vocabulary; measures paraphrase inference.

cases.prompt: this three.js product shot looks generic, like every other AI demo
cases.rationale: The ban-list case: the fix is naming the defaults it used, not a vaguer 'make it premium'.

cases.prompt: use motion-lab to render anim.html and give me a contact sheet I can annotate
cases.rationale: Explicit invocation by name; the renderer, sheet and frame labels are the expected path.

cases.prompt: the remotion explainer's cuts drift off the music by the end
cases.rationale: Beat-grid drift in a Remotion piece; motion_math beats, not a hand-tuned offset.

cases.prompt: export this canvas animation as a GIF for an X article and check the timing
cases.rationale: Last-mile export plus a measured GIF timing check.

cases.prompt: add a hover animation to the pricing card button
cases.rationale: UI micro-interaction in a live app: the animate skill or the Motion library, not a rendered clip.

cases.prompt: cut the 40 minute podcast into three vertical clips
generate a cinematic video of a surfer at sunset
cases.rationale: Generated footage from a video model: higgsfield / ltx-video.

cases.prompt: make the launch video with the liquid glass look, floating panels and particles
cases.rationale: That fixed aesthetic is launch-video's brief; motion-lab would ban half of it.
